newsitem.title: USA: Nordstrom to build Seattle office tower.
newsitem.headline: Nordstrom to build Seattle office tower.

text.p: Nordstrom Inc plans to develop an office tower of up to 25 stories in downtown Seattle for its corporate offices, company chairman John Whitacre said Tuesday at the company's annual shareholders meeting.
Whitacre said the $70 million building, to be located near the company's new flagship retail store, would be open in 2001.

Nordstrom is developing the 380,000-square-foot building building jointly with Clise Properties Inc and expects to occupy at least 90 percent of the building, consolidating offices currently in six downtown Seattle locations.

Whitacre also said the company would enter the Florida market in 2000 with a store in Boca Raton, and would open a St. Louis location in 2001. The company also plans to open its second full-line store in the Atlanta area in 2000.
Whitacre told reporters after the meeting that sales trends had been encouraging since the end of the fourth quarter and said women's apparel inventories were in good shape.
